articles.summary: In today’s rapidly evolving maritime mission space, one question matters more than any other: when the environment is contested, which systems are ready to perform?
articles.title: Proven Robotics for Contested Maritime Environments

articles.summary: Production of the Mobile Strike Force Vehicle (MSFV) is officially underway at Textron Systems’ Slidell, La. manufacturing facility, marking an important milestone in the company’s ongoing support to U.S. partners and allied ground forces.
articles.title: MSFV Production Begins at Textron Systems’ Slidell, La. Facility
